label: AfterShip
description: Send Swell shipments to AfterShip as trackings and bring their delivery status back to the order. In AfterShip, create an API key in Settings → API keys and copy the webhook secret from Settings → Webhooks.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the API key and the webhook secret

actions.label: Send existing shipments
actions.hint: Sends recent shipments with a tracking number that are not in AfterShip yet

modal.title: Send existing shipments
modal.description: Creates an AfterShip tracking for each shipment with a tracking number that the app hasn't sent yet, using the current settings. Canceled shipments are skipped. Runs in the background.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: AfterShip → Settings → API keys. A key with the default permissions works; if you restrict it, allow reading and writing trackings.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns off everything the app sends to AfterShip and ignores incoming webhooks, without uninstalling it

fields.label: Shipments
fields.description: Shipments with a tracking number become AfterShip trackings. AfterShip then tracks them with the carrier and, if you've set them up in AfterShip, sends its own notifications to the customer.

fields.label: Send shipments to AfterShip
fields.description: Creates a tracking when a shipment gets a tracking number, and a new one when the number changes

fields.label: Share customer contact
fields.description: Sends the customer's name, email and phone with the tracking, so AfterShip notifications can reach them

fields.label: Delete trackings of canceled shipments
fields.description: Deletes the AfterShip tracking when the shipment is canceled or deleted in Swell

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Comma-separated tags added to every tracking in AfterShip

fields.label: Tracking updates
fields.description: AfterShip sends status changes to the webhook below; the app also refreshes trackings still in transit every hour.

fields.label: Webhook secret
fields.description: AfterShip → Settings → Webhooks → webhook secret. Required: webhooks without a valid signature are rejected.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.description: Replace {store-id} with your store ID and {public-key} with a Swell public key (Developer → API keys; test key for test, live key for live), then add it in AfterShip → Settings → Webhooks.
